data.description:
## Goal
Create check-manifest-completeness.sh to verify that a completion-verifier JSON output contains all required audit-trail fields. T3's test suite must be written first (RED) and must pass after this task (GREEN).

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-manifest-completeness.sh (reads JSON from stdin or file; validates presence of criteria_results, consumer_smoke_tests, ticket_id, overall_verdict, remediation_tasks_created; exits 0 if complete, 1 if any field missing)

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/check-manifest-completeness.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-manifest-completeness.sh exits 0 (all 3 cases GREEN — use T3 test suite run, not manual /tmp fixture steps)
- Script handles missing file argument gracefully (exits 2 with usage message)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends T3)
data.title: T4: RED — Create check-manifest-completeness.sh
